routes.title: Become Cube: free Aion 2 build planner and character analyzer
routes.description: Type your Aion 2 character name for stigma picks, a rotation, Daevanion and gear upgrades for boss, AoE, leveling and burst. Free fan tool.
routes.intro: Import a character from the official Aion 2 armory, or build one by hand, and compare boss, AoE, leveling and burst playstyles: stigmas, rotation, Daevanion and your next upgrades.

routes.title: Start here: how to use Become Cube for Aion 2
routes.description: A short guide to the Aion 2 build planner: import your character, read the four playstyle cards, and apply the stigma, Daevanion and gear advice.
routes.intro: New to Aion 2 or to this site? This page walks through importing a character, reading the results, and what to change first.

routes.title: Aion 2 build planner: make a build by hand
routes.description: Pick an Aion 2 class, enter your level and stats, and get the same stigma, rotation and Daevanion analysis without importing a character.
routes.intro: No character yet? Pick a class, enter level and stats, and get the same analysis as an imported character.

routes.title: Aion 2 Daevanion planner: best node order
routes.description: Plan your Aion 2 Daevanion boards: which nodes to open first for the biggest damage gain, based on your class and current build.
routes.intro: See which Daevanion nodes add the most damage and in what order to open them.

routes.title: Compare two Aion 2 characters side by side
routes.description: Compare two Aion 2 characters or builds side by side: stigmas, gear, Daevanion and estimated damage for each playstyle.
routes.intro: Put two characters next to each other to see how their stigmas, gear and estimated damage differ.

routes.title: Aion 2 skill codex: skills, stigmas and specialties by class
routes.description: Browse Aion 2 skills, stigmas and specialties for every class with ranks, cooldowns and what each option changes.
routes.intro: A reference for every class's skills, stigmas and specialty options.

routes.title: Aion 2 keybinds and macro setup for your rotation
routes.description: Turn your Aion 2 rotation into a key layout and an in-game macro you set up yourself. Nothing is sent to the game.
routes.intro: Lay out your skills on the hotbar and build the in-game macro for your rotation.

routes.title: Aion 2 crafting shopping list and recipes
routes.description: Pick Aion 2 crafting recipes and get the full shopping list of base materials in one place.
routes.intro: Choose recipes and get a combined list of the materials you need.

routes.title: Aion 2 road map: what to do at each level
routes.description: A level-by-level checklist for Aion 2: what to unlock, upgrade and farm next as your character grows.
routes.intro: A level-by-level list of what to do next for your class.

routes.title: Aion 2 board: recent lookups and top characters
routes.description: The latest Aion 2 characters looked up on Become Cube and the top characters by Combat Power. Public armory info only.
routes.intro: Recent lookups and the top characters. Public armory info only.

routes.title: Aion 2 interactive map and party pins | Become Cube
routes.description: Explore the Aion 2 interactive map with zones, bosses, portals and gathering nodes, or share a party pin board. Unofficial fan tool.
routes.intro: Explore zones, find locations, and share party pins.
